lena (AE): Intro - prospect (FinSys) asked if we can run a 3-week on-prem POC in a strictly air-gapped datacenter. They want delivery via courier (encrypted USB) and a documented chain-of-custody. What are the main blockers?
mike (SE): We support courier transfer. Preferred: signed tarball + detached signature + manifest.json with sha256 checksums. Provide cosign public key for verification. Example: `cosign verify --key redwood.pub bundle.tar.gz.sig`
hana (SRE): For infra, recommend 2 nodes (1 GPU, 1 CPU) for evaluation. Runtime base ~2.4GB, quantized model ~10GB, tooling ~500MB. Expect transfer size ~13GB total. If they need larger models, plan for external hard drive delivery.
lena (AE): They specifically asked about upgrade cadence during POC and whether we can freeze changes.
mike (SE): Yes - we can produce a POC-stable bundle (no automatic updates). For production we offer monthly delta bundles. For the POC we will create a one-off signed artifact and provide an emergency patch process.
reza (security): Security notes: we can offer full SBOM and an SLSA attestation for the artifact. They'll ask about key management - we can do offline license activation using a signed license file bound to an installation ID. If they require HSM wrapping for keys, that's an add-on. Also confirm whether export control / encryption regs apply.
clare (legal): We need their transfer SOP and who signs NDAs. Also request their data handling requirements for logs. We'll share SOC2 + ISO attestation under NDA.
lena (AE): Can we give them a simple install verification they can run offline? Something like a smoke test and hash verify?
hana (SRE): Smoke test script (offline): `sha256sum bundle.tar.gz && ./install.sh --offline --license /tmp/license.sig && /opt/redwood/bin/smoke_test --prompts prompts.json --out results.json` will produce a pass/fail code. We'll provide expected hashes and sample prompts.
mike (SE): Also provide verify steps for container registry option: `skopeo inspect --raw docker-daemon:bundle:latest | jq -r .` and signed manifest. But for courier, tarball flow is simplest.
lena (AE): Pricing/terms? They want to know if courier signing/dedicated support costs extra for a short POC.
clare (legal): POC (<=30 days) is complimentary. One-off artifact signing and packaging included. If they require custom compliance (FIPS, HSM integration), that goes into an enterprise addendum and may have fees.
reza (security): One more: chain-of-custody checklist we require: courier name, shipment manifest, serial for USB, checksum pre/post, time-window for install. We should add tamper-evidence stickers recommendation.
mike (SE): I'll prepare a runbook snippet + manifest example and a small FAQ about rollback (we support reinstalling prior signed bundle) and offline log collection (we provide collector script and instructions to scp to their audit server).
deploy-bot: Artifact signed: redwood-bundle-1758010001.tar.gz.sig (cosign)
lena (AE): Thanks! Can we get the runbook + SBOM + cosign pubkey by EOD? I'll attach to the SOW and ask FinSys for their transfer SOP and security questionnaire.
clare (legal): I'll prep NDA + SOC2 delivery under NDA.
reza (security): I'll include the SLSA attestation and sample license activation command: `curl -s --data @install-id.json --output license.sig "https://activate.redwood.example/offline"` (we'll provide an alternate offline signing workflow via signed token for strict air-gapped).
lena (AE): Great team. I'll book kickoff and share buyer checklist with the courier window options.
mike (SE): FYI: if they insist on FIPS-only crypto we'll need 2-3 week lead time to swap signing keys and validate images. Flagging now.
